questions.question: My father ____ going to wash his car.
questions.explanation: 主语 My father 是第三人称单数，be动词选is。

knowledge.core_concept: 表示即将发生的动作或未来的计划打算。
knowledge.key_formula: 主语 + am/is/are + going to + 动词原形 (V-base)
common_mistakes: going to 后面接了动词 ing 形式
be 动词与主语不匹配（如 I is ...）
knowledge.tips: 标志词有 tomorrow, next week, tonight, this afternoon。
